meta.task: Design a battery for a smartphone: volumetric energy density >= 950 Wh/L, support 4C fast charge (no lithium plating), maximum temperature <= 50C, anode SEI thickness <= 500 nm after 100 cycles, voltage plateau >= 4.1 V.
meta.base_params: Chen2020 (default, no explicit electrode system in task text; voltage plateau >=4.1 V exceeds NMC811 ceiling -> escalate to high-voltage LNMO system data/LNMO.json)

freedoms.electrode_system: adjustable (task text does not lock; voltage plateau requirement forces high-voltage cathode)

meta.units_note: 50 C = 323.15 K; plateau = calc-energy midpoint_voltage_v; ED volumetric = calc-energy energy_density_wh_l (contract caliber, electrolyte/casing excluded)
